RequiredDocumentsCard.info:
What does the AI do?

The AI compares the uploaded planning documents with the documents required for the approval design under the “Guidelines for the Planning Process and for the Uniform Design of Road Construction Design Documents”, version 2012 (RE 2012). The document title and document content are both considered for the comparison.

The AI assigns each submitted document to a document type according to RE 2012, such as “site plan”. Several documents can be assigned to the same document type, for example when several site plans are available.

A document type counts as “available” as soon as at least one document is assigned to it. Additional documents of that document type may still be required.

If a project requires additional document types that are not listed in RE 2012, they can be added via the pencil icon. These are not considered by the AI.

If individual documents listed in RE 2012 are not required for the specific project, such as an EIA report for a project that does not require an environmental impact assessment, the hint for that document type can be hidden.

TableOfContentsCard.info:
What does the AI do?

The AI searches the planning documents for a table of contents.

If the AI detects a table of contents, the agent compares the submitted planning documents with the entries in the table of contents. The “hints” indicate when documents listed in the table of contents were not found among the uploaded files.

If a document is available, for example under a different name, the “hint” can be hidden. Missing documents can be requested.

EditRequiredDocumentsDialog.title: Edit required documents
EditRequiredDocumentsDialog.description:
The documents required for federal trunk road plan approval procedures under the “Guidelines for the Planning Process and for the Uniform Design of Road Construction Design Documents”, version 2012 (RE 2012), for the approval design cannot be edited.

Hints for documents that are not required for this project can be hidden in the overview.

Additional document types required for this project can be added under “Custom”. Custom document types are not assigned by the AI; documents can be assigned to them manually.

startDialog.title: Start AI analysis of the documents
startDialog.description:
Starting processing begins the AI-assisted formal completeness check of the available documents. This process can take several hours. While processing is running, no changes can be made to the project.

Note: If another project is already being processed by the AI, please start this project only after the running processing has finished.
